svg.desc: Balgran Substations Package LOCATION KSA CLIENT General Electric (GE)/Saudi Electric Company (SEC) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2021 70 million SAR each DISCIPLINES Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This completed substation project in KSA, led by General Electric (GE) in partnership with the Saudi Electric Company (SEC), includes the development of two main substations-Balgran and Bisha-as well as two extensions in El Arida and Sabya. Each substation is valued at approximately 70 million SAR. The project aims to enhance the national power grid's capacity and stability through advanced electrical infrastructure and reliable substation design, contributing to the Kingdom's growing energy needs.
